title: Side One
description: Browse seven landmark releases across nine pressings, inspect every sleeve and track list, and cue a record on a configurable 3D turntable.

prompt.objective: Build a tactile 3D vinyl shelf with inspectable sleeves, track lists, and a working turntable ritual.

mintAssets.brief: Three web-ready turntable chassis shells in walnut, aluminium, and clear acrylic.

experience: Browse by drag, wheel, keyboard, or index, then inspect any sleeve.
Choose a track, move its record to the platter, switch chassis, and return it.
prompt.visualDirection: Cream paper, walnut cabinetry, crisp serif type, black vinyl, and warm-metal accents.

thumbnail.alt: A black vinyl record with a red center label emerging from a minimal cream sleeve beside the Side One wordmark.
